headline: About 64 in 100 Malaysians aged 18 to 38 use TikTok regularly
why: Usage is higher among Malay audiences and in the Lower M40 income group.
idea: Short-form video stays the default format; brief creators by income and audience group.

headline: TikTok Shop outperforms traditional marketplaces in some lifestyle and beauty categories
why: Social commerce is moving sales off marketplaces in some categories.
idea: Build a TikTok Shop bundle for a Thai launch.

headline: Over 70% of Thai marketers report measurable ROI from influencer campaigns
why: Native-style creator content is beating polished brand ads.
idea: Move from one-off posts to longer creator partnerships.

headline: Singaporeans use 7.4 platforms a month and spend about 17 hours a week on social
why: Attention is split across many platforms, with WhatsApp leading monthly use.
idea: Plan across few platforms and go deep rather than spreading thin.

headline: TikTok leads daily engagement at 1 hour 39 minutes a day; YouTube leads session length
why: Video dominates attention, and social drives brand discovery.
idea: Lead with video on TikTok and use YouTube for longer stories.

headline: YouTube is the most-watched mobile app and reaches 80% of internet users
why: Video is the default place Australians spend time online.
idea: Plan YouTube as the anchor for longer creator stories.

headline: Six in ten Australians use social to research brands
why: Forums and community boards count as research, not only feeds.
idea: Seed honest product Q&A in community spaces.

headline: Social ads are the third most common source of brand discovery, after search and word of mouth
why: Social is a discovery channel, not only a retention channel.
idea: Measure reach and discovery, not only engagement.

headline: LINE has about 54 million users, so LINE Official Accounts drive loyalty and direct sales
why: Conversational commerce is a core channel for Thai brands.
idea: Run a LINE loyalty offer alongside TikTok content.

headline: A standard grocery basket at Woolworths rose 8.5%, from $213.89 in March 2025 to $232.02 in July 2026
why: Cost of living is the everyday story for Australian shoppers, and price-sensitive messaging is likely to land.
idea: Lead with everyday value and portion messaging in Australia.

headline: Muma Malaysia's ONE Asia 2026 call for entries is made by hand, without AI
why: A human-craft campaign is a clear counter-message in an AI-driven creative industry.
idea: Pitch a human-made creative angle when AI-made work is the norm.

headline: 42% of Asia Pacific consumers would interact with a brand's AI agent if offered one
why: Consumers are open to AI agents, but only 14% of brands have embedded agentic AI across the organisation.
idea: Keep an option to reach a human in every AI-led brand experience.

headline: 74% of organisations cite data integration and quality as the main barrier to scaling AI
why: Brands are held back by data, not by ideas, which affects how AI creative can be scaled.
idea: Check data readiness before committing to AI-led campaigns.

headline: A trader's guide to navigating Malaysia's 2027 Budget plan
why: Analysts expect cash handouts to rise to about RM17 billion from RM15 billion in 2026, supporting mass-market spending.
idea: Brief the team on which retail and food categories analysts flag as Budget beneficiaries before the next snack pitch.

headline: Thai September inflation rises to 2.82% on fuel and fresh food; 2026 forecast narrows to 1.8-2.2%
why: Households are watching prices as fuel and food costs push inflation higher.
idea: Rising costs favour value-pack messaging; test price-led creative before premium claims.

headline: Consumer Sector May Find Support In Budget 2027
why: Kenanga keeps its OVERWEIGHT rating and expects Budget 2027 support to sustain household spending.
idea: Test value and everyday-affordability messages in the next snack campaign.

headline: Verstappen wins the 2026 Singapore Grand Prix on his 250th start
why: F1 race week drives visitors and brand activations around Marina Bay.
idea: Brands with F1 partnerships can run race-week content while the buzz is live.

headline: Thailand inflation hits 2.82% in September as fuel costs bite
why: Fuel costs are the everyday story; households are watching prices.
idea: Value and price-stability messaging fits the mood.

headline: Opposition vows the biggest cut to migration in Australia's history
why: Migration and cost of living are dominating the political agenda.
idea: Avoid politically charged framing; focus on everyday, shared moments.
